_README.purpose: Concept vocabulary for embedding-derived tagging of SGGS. Replaces LLM string-voting, which had 2% survival for specific concepts and missed 4 of the 5 thieves entirely.
how_to_edit: include: set false to drop a concept entirely.
description: this exact English text is embedded. Lines are embedded on their English translation, so write it the way BaniDB renders the idea.
anchors_accept: Gurmukhi token PREFIXES. Any word starting with these counts as a lexical positive.
anchors_reject: prefixes to exclude. This is where the traps live (see notes).
confirmed_by_ujjal: flip to true when you're happy with a concept. I won't build until you say go.
ADD concepts freely: copy the shape of any entry. lexical_shabads is recomputed by the builder.
rulings: dated decisions by Ujjal that shaped the entry.

word_senses: words whose sense decides the concept. For a token starting with the word (longest word first), the first sense whose english_any pattern is found and whose english_none pattern is absent in the verse's BaniDB English decides the concept; concept null, or no matching sense, means the word counts for nothing. Patterns are regular expressions; (?i) makes one case-insensitive.
infer: false counts word evidence only; nothing is inferred from translation similarity. For word senses such as Sahaj (ease).
calibration: description sets the threshold from the description alone, as for description-only concepts, while the words still count as evidence. For concepts whose words are few or varied.
_README.anchors_are_seeds_not_rules: Anchors only seed each concept's prototype vector and calibrate its threshold. Final tagging is by embedding similarity, so a shabad that teaches ego without saying ਹਉਮੈ still gets tagged.
